name: Anemone
source:
Main character witnesses a catastrophe on the way home - an alien dies on his hands telling of evil alien conspiracy. Protagonist receives radar to track aliens locations, and it points to his own house where his six sisters live. One of his elder sisters is an evil alien... he needs to find the culprit and have his justice.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公回家途中目睹了一场灾难：一名外星人死在他怀中，并在临终前透露邪恶外星人的阴谋。主人公得到一台追踪外星人位置的雷达，雷达却指向住着六个姐妹的自己家中。某个姐姐是邪恶外星人…他必须找出真凶，伸张正义。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
